concept.description: Verifies presence of the test properties file.
concept.cypher: match (:Maven:Project)-[:CONTAINS]->(config:File)-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File:Properties) where config.path = "config" and config.fileName = "/config" and f.path = "config/test.properties" and f.fileName = "/test.properties" return f

concept.description: Verifies presence of the test properties file identified by its URL.
concept.cypher: match (:Maven:Project)-[:CONTAINS]->(f:File:Properties) where f.path = "file:config/test.properties" and f.fileName = "config/test.properties" return f
